title: Using AI to mitigate the growing environmental threat of data centers
script:
Data centers consume massive amounts of energy. MIT researcher Christina Delimitrou is working to fix that.
She explores how artificial intelligence can mitigate their growing environmental threat.
Servers demand continuous power while dealing with fluctuating workloads every day.
Can smart scheduling curb their massive carbon footprint?
